findings.where: app/test/e2e/landing.test.js LD-5 section G (the stress -3 with the 1 px widening), section F (the 4 px rule); mutant M16 of 05l
findings.what: The claim that the title is 4 px or more from «Назад» is not pinned apart from the layout's own gap. M16 as written (the base `.ask-h` gap 20px to 0) is equal in effect, because the phone rule `gap: 2px 10px` overrides it at 320 to 420 px. The live form M16b (the phone gap 0) and a gap of 3 px (G3) leave G green: the stress -3 is made 1 px wider by the resize, so the title ends exactly 4 px before the column edge and `text.right > btn.left - 4` does not fire at the border. They turn H red only by chance (question 2 goes beside at 320 px on this PC's font) and with a speaker font 12 percent larger only F at 375 and 379 px turns red, again by the width of a title (C1, C2). On another font M16b can survive all three sections.
findings.fix: In G make the window 1 px narrower instead of wider for the stress rows (-3 then ends 2 px before the edge, +6 becomes +7), so a gap under 2 px is red; or stress to 0 and assert 4 px with the error budget. Optional: name M16 as equal in effect in the list.
